Design an isotropic all-dielectric planar multilayer polarizing beam splitter on a fused-silica substrate for incidence from air at 45 degrees. Across 500-650 nm, favor high TE reflectance and high TM transmittance. Use only MgF2, SiO2, Ta2O5, and TiO2; compare structures with 6, 10, and 14 finite layers, with each layer constrained to 25-220 nm. Treat mean TE reflectance of at least 90% and mean TM transmittance of at least 85% as soft goals, while also rewarding fewer layers and lower total thickness. Report the best-performance, most-robust, and simplest candidates rather than imposing a hard feasibility threshold. Evaluate numerical manufacturing sensitivity using independent normally distributed layer-thickness errors with a standard deviation of 1.5% of each nominal thickness and a common incidence-angle offset bounded by plus or minus 1 degree.
